subject: showcase
caption:
Guest arrival, twelve thirty. Nuptial mass at one. Dancing at half past five.

Most guests do not know when to arrive, so they either come too early and wait outside the church, or they come late and slip in during the vows. Neither is what you wanted.

A timeline on the page fixes it quietly. They check it the night before, on their own.

Message us your event date and we will lay yours out.
